tbesh_html:
Ramoth= "heights"

Another name of ba.a.lat be.er (בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר "Baalath-beer" H1192)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Ramoth-Negeb or Ramath-Negeb, a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or רָמַת נֶגֶב; from the plural or construct form of H7413 (רָמָה) and H5045 (נֶגֶב); heights (or height) of the South;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: south Ramoth, Ramath of the south.
